<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|44|THE GOSPEL|CHA. XVI.}}</noinclude>{{verse|chapter=16|verse=1}}AND there came to him the Pharisees and Sadducees tempting: and they demaunded him to shevv them a signe from heauen.{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mar. 8, 12.''}} {{verse|chapter=16|verse=2}}† But he answered & said to them, When it is euening, you say, It vvil be faire-wether, for the element is redde.{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 12, 54.''}} {{verse|chapter=16|verse=3}}† And in the morning, This day there vvil be a tempest, for the element doth glovve and lovvre. The face therfore of the element you haue skil to discerne: and the signes of times can you not? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=4}}† The {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mat. 12, 39.''}}* naughtie and aduouterous generation seeketh for a signe: and there shal not a signe be giuen it, but the signe of Ionas the Prophet. And he left them and vvent avvay.

{{verse|chapter=16|verse=5}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mar. 8, 14.''}}* vvhen his disciples vvere come ouer the vvater, they forgot to take bread. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=6}}† Who said to them, Looke vvel and bevvare of the leauen of the Pharisees & Sadducees.{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Lu. 12, 1.''}} {{verse|chapter=16|verse=7}}† But they thought vvithin them selues saying, Because we tooke not bread. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=8}}† And IESVS knovving it, said, Why do you thinke vvithin your selues O ye of litle faith, for that you haue not bread? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=9}}† Do you not yet vnderstand, neither do you remember {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mat. 14, 17. 15, 34.''}}* the fiue loaues among fiue thousand men, and how many baskets you tooke vp? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=10}}† neither the seuen loaues, among foure thousand men, and hovv many maundes you tooke vp? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=11}}† Why do you not vnderstand that I said not of bread to you, Bevvare of the leauen of the Pharisees & Sadducees? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=12}}† Then they vnderstoode that he said not they should bevvare of the leauen of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

{{verse|chapter=16|verse=13}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpon SS. Peter and Paules day Iun. 29. ''And in Cathedra Petri Romæ, Ian. 18. & Antiochiæ Febr. 22. And Petri ad vincula Aug. 1''. And on the day of the creation and coronation of the Pope, and on the Anniuersarie thereof.}}And {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mar. 8, 27. Luc. 9, 18.''}}* IESVS came into the quarters of Cæsarea Philippi: and he asked his disciples, saying, ‖ Whom say men that the Sonne of man is? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=14}}† ‖ But they said, Some Iohn the Baptist, & othersome Elias, and others Hieremie, or one of the Prophets. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=15}}† IESVS saith to them, But vvhom do you say that I am? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=16}}† Simon Peter ansvvered & said, Thou art Christ the sonne of the liuing God. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=17}}† And IESVS ansvvering, said to him, ‖ Blessed art thou Simon bar-Iona: because flesh & bloud hath not reuealed it to thee, but my father vvhich is in heauen. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=18}}† ‖ And I say to thee, ‖ ''That thou art'' {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 1, 42.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ That is, a Rocke.}}∷ Peter: ‖ ''and vpon this'' ‖ Rocke ''vvil I ‖ build my Church, and the ‖ gates of hel shal not preuaile'' against it. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=19}}† ''And I'' {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 21, 15.''}}* ''vvil giue ‖ to thee ‖ the keies of the kingdom of heauen. And ‖ vvhatsoeuer thou shalt binde vpon earth, it shal be bound also in the heauens: and whatsoeuer thou shalt ‖ loose in earth, it shall be loosed also in the heauens''.⊣
